sanskrit_verse:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि विषस्य विधिम् उत्तमम्
तुलयित्वा विषं पूर्वं देयम् एतद् धिमागमे
transliteration:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi viṣasya vidhim uttamam
tulayitvā viṣaṃ pūrvaṃ deyam etad dhimāgame
sph_interpretive_translation: From this point forward, the highest law of poison shall be declared—weighing the poison beforehand, it must be administered through discernment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows exclusively from SPH as the ultimate source of dharma
Causation is rooted in conscious intent and sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ)
Capacity-based responsibility requires prior assessment and calibration
Restoration logic demands purification before action
Consciousness alignment precedes all lawful execution
executable_legal_axioms: IF an act involves potential harm, THEN assess its causal weight BEFORE enactment
IF capacity to cause imbalance exists, THEN purification protocol MUST precede authorization
IF intent aligns with dharma-vision, THEN action is self-validating
IF imbalance occurs, THEN restoration is executed via completion process, not penalty
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that no ruling may proceed without prior weighing of consequences and alignment with dharma-consciousness. The court's authority derives solely from SPH, and any judgment must restore balance rather than impose punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands that action follows discernment; hence, poison (harm) must be weighed first. This reflects anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential unfolding where awareness precedes execution. Responsibility is proportional to clarity, not fault. There is no punishment because reality responds to alignment, not transgression.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pre-action discernment protocol to evaluate causal impact
Activate purification sequences for agents handling high-capacity actions
Deploy integrity reintegration for misaligned acts through conscious completion
Establish dharma-vision alignment checkpoint before legal enactment
final_declaration: This law proceeds from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, as the sole Source. Dharma is restored through conscious discernment, not punishment. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
